# ABREU & BRUM

ABREU & BRUM is a Brazilian cybersecurity, PenTest and consulting company. Its primary offering is AB Scan, a B2B solution for authorized security assessment of company domains.

Primary site: https://abreuebrum.com.br/

## Main Product

AB Scan helps companies understand security risks on authorized domains, receive professional reports with prioritized evidence, and decide clearly when to advance to a manual PenTest.

The product is not an open offensive tool. Domain authorization is mandatory before any assessment. The positioning is commercial, responsible and B2B.

## Customer Journey

- Explain AB Scan on the landing page.
- Offer a free initial assessment to understand exposure.
- Use the full paid report as the path to a professional PDF.
- Convert the paid report amount into credit for manual PenTest for 90 days when applicable.
- Position manual PenTest as the complementary next step when deeper validation is needed.

## Key Themes

- Web security assessment for companies.
- Domain security evaluation.
- Professional web security report.
- Vulnerability report with evidence.
- Risk prioritization and practical recommendations.
- Public exposure analysis.
- Supplier approval and contract security evidence.
- Manual web PenTest as a complementary service.
